But after thousands of pictures of Epstein's water heaters, bookshelves, gravel pits, and empty memory cards, people get bored and shuffle out. The social media commentary dies down. Not me. I'm looking in those drawers filled with cosplay, wondering how it lines up with the dentist chair, and that weird Coney Island art on the walls. I wonder why a guy took a $60 million mansion and decorated it like a Hot Topic. I want to know what's on those blurry documents sitting on his desk. I'm reading every label of every floppy disk. I'm image-searching obscure sex toys (unbeknownst to me). I'm double-checking every redacted photo to see if I can find another copy online, careful to avoid AI fakes. | | ---|---|--- My favorites are the emails, those long threads of weird conversations that no one ever thought would be made public. Moments where bad men let their guard down and brag about their indiscretions, acting like little boys wondering "will she call me back?" when a 20-something flight attendant stops by their hotel room thousands of miles away. Academics suddenly like frat boys. Wall Street's finest toeing the line of their own sexual preference, just for favor from a guy who seemingly has it all and nothing at the same time. The descriptions of not just any girl, but a special one--young, blonde, skinny, childlike. Maybe she's 18, but she doesn't look like it. | | ---|---|--- I sometimes feel like the DOJ knows when I'm offline. It's impossible, but it always seems to line up with a kid's birthday or a trip into the city, and my phone blows up. This time I was headed in to hang out with , whom I'd met at the Substack Notes meetup last fall. "I like your nametag" I said, like an idiot. But the "" had a nice ring to it. And then they dropped the files, all 3.5 million of them. Coincidence? If you believe in that sort of thing... While we chatted, I thought I could hear my phone buzzing, and buzzing, and buzzing through the closet wall where I'd hung my coat. I couldn't, but my brain wouldn't let go of those files. I knew what was waiting for me. I knew people wanted to know what I'd found. I knew influencers had already grabbed the biggest headlines and were posting wild and unexpected finds all over social media. Me, I was not in a hurry. Four-thousand files had been work. | | | Hi -- it's Adam Schiff, DSCC Vice Chair.

**In a moment, I'm going to talk to you about something deeply important, both to me personally and to the future of our nation. But first, I have to ask:[_Will you chip in $7 right now to help flip the Senate blue and take power away from the MAGA majority as they work to enact Trump's dangerous agenda?_](https://go.dscc.org/go/22717?t=17&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&code=DPE-FD-20260206-AdamSchiff-SchiffSpecialElectionv2-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20260206-AdamSchiff-SchiffSpecialElectionv2-Pros-sl1&akid=22641%2E9716520%2E6YYmNU)**

As someone who has won a special election to the Senate, I cannot emphasize enough the importance of this. Democrats only need a few seats to flip the Senate majority, and with the GOP defending more seats than they were expecting, we have a real chance to catch them flat-footed.

clean_body: Last night’s results are setting off a complete political shockwave. | | | Peter, With over 90% of the vote counted, last night’s special primary in New Jersey’s 11th district is setting off a political shockwave : Analilia Mejia — a Working Families Party leader — is winning in the special election for New Jersey’s 11th Congressional District! This wasn’t just a referendum on the issues that voters want Congress to address. It was also a warning shot to the entire political establishment. Analilia’s performance yesterday was historic. She shocked the New Jersey political establishment, and did what so many people said she couldn’t. Working people in New Jersey and across the country are sick and tired of the status quo and hungryfor real leadership — and Analilia's performance was proof of that. She ran on standing up for workers’ rights, economic justice, and a democracy that belongs to everyday people, not corporate interests. Those are issues that are resonating across the entire country. Now, our mission is to keep this energy going. ** The Working Families Party has been a force in New Jersey for years. We’ve notched some big wins in the Garden State, helping to overturn the corrupt “county line” ballot design system and electing a number of champions in just the past few years. This is one of our biggest wins yet. And it’s only the beginning of what could be an even bigger year for our movement, not just in Jersey but across the country. There’s a reason the other side works so hard to discredit our work and our champions. The billionaire class knows that the biggest threat to their power is a unified, multi-racial working-class movement like the one we’re building with candidates like Analilia and other Working Families Party champions. | Good morning Friend, As we head into the final days before **Education Freedom** on **Tuesday, February 10** , one question keeps coming up: **Who should be in the room for this conversation?** When education policy meets resistance, the most important discussions don’t happen online — they happen in rooms like this one. This luncheon brings together a national leader in school choice, Mississippi advocates working on the ground, and engaged citizens who care deeply about what comes next for education in our state. It’s a chance to move beyond headlines and talk honestly about strategy, lessons learned, and the path forward. We’ll hear from **Corey DeAngelis** , one of the most influential voices in the national school choice movement, alongside Mississippi leaders who are navigating education policy realities every day:
* **Starla Brown** , State Director of Americans for Prosperity Mississippi
* **Lindsey Beckham** , State Chair and Legislative Chair for Moms for Liberty
* **Leah Ferretti** , Director of Mississippi Ready

This is the room for:
* Parents who want a meaningful voice in their children’s education
* Policymakers and advocates tracking education reform beyond a single vote
* Community and business leaders invested in Mississippi’s long-term future
* Anyone who wants to understand what comes next — and how change actually happens

The SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. Now Trump and his MAGA minions are meeting with U.S. Senators, scheming for ways to get this bill through the Senate ahead of November's midterms.
This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.

* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration

name: Pennsylvania Forward Party
subject: PA FWD Party February Newsletter
body:
It's time to find Candidates

|
##
## How We Win in 2026
We've been building a foundation for 4 years. Now 2026 is our time to seize the moment... and the road to change is through the PA State House. There are 203 State House seats, with a margin of only ONE seat between Republicans and Democrats! State House seats are often filled by party loyalists with no connection to their constituents. We can change that! All across the state, there are potential leaders who could run for these offices and win. The system is built to keep them out, but the Forward Party is built to let them in. Help us help them. Together, we can move Harrisburg _Forward_.
### What makes a great candidate?
* Connection to their community
* Clear communication of their ideas
* A collaborative, solution-oriented mindset
* Addressing local issues (state and community)

### Where can Forwardists win?
* Uncontested races _(nearly 50% in PA)_
where no one is running against the incumbent
* Districts that aren't competitive _(nearly 75% in PA)_
because the same party always wins
* Anywhere that local issues aren't being addressed by the people in charge

### Where to find information for your district?
1. Use the PA site [Find My Legislator ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=2Ycjns7oB5o-0odxkGw2JSr2iIcKFyRcbCGqfd4fNPIzvIXNW5BK1vle7DTtjbw4&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_february_newsletter&n=1) to look up your house district
2. Use [Ballotpedia](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=N-ZescOAqg88fULNXku0buO7wvHMzu5LaEqbsXcrIuc4EQAedjh2QgfdpHGzn-5-7kOm3b_GkKj4TrHAlge4EQ&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_february_newsletter&n=2) to find your representative and the results of past elections
3. Email [Pennsylvania@Forwardparty.com](mailto:Pennsylvania@Forwardparty.com) to discuss running in your district (or recommend someone who can)

* * *
### Welcome our newest elected Forwardist!
The Pennsylvania Forward Party is thrilled to announce the affiliation of the recently elected independent Mayor of Dallastown Borough, Kristine Cousler Womack. Kristine has been a friend and supporter since the beginning of our party. She attended our first Gettysburg summit in 2023 and stood with us in Harrisburg in 2024. Kristine has a long history of fighting for her community and supporting independent/3rd-party candidates. We're proud to support her Mayorship and we're looking forward to working together.
* * *
### Special Election Excitement
Four special elections for State House races were already scheduled and we'll be reaching out to supporters in those areas to remind them to vote for these very important races [(Districts 22, 42, 79, 193)](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=N-ZescOAqg88fULNXku0buO7wvHMzu5LaEqbsXcrIuc4EQAedjh2QgfdpHGzn-5-7kOm3b_GkKj4TrHAlge4EQ&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_february_newsletter&n=3). Now a fifth special election has been announced—and it's an exciting one! [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=lRFe1ojb2I3keveG6F1SNMpqnyA5DC-f4K2CG-ffZH4&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_february_newsletter&n=4) On January's statewide call, we heard from recently-announced Forward affiliate [Ron Ruman](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=lRFe1ojb2I3keveG6F1SNMpqnyA5DC-f4K2CG-ffZH4&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_february_newsletter&n=5). He told us about his plan to run as a Forward Democrat for the PA State House in the 196th district (York County). The seat interests him because the sitting representative, Seth Grove, is not running for reelection, so this will be a great opportunity to bring something new to Harrisburg. Then, last week, the excitement ramped up when [Seth Grove announced his resignation](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=r8GUuOQxF8CLp0v0VBrYrcEtEmg_oM2RAhH5umXYQbh858R2aWsreJWeEHyCj0DkKsJ2qCggP20MmEr1PvdoNKkQh4AZOocRELs4D-yMF0fP_iylejnXWeVyKYNLTqwd57YrPbop6CagPEUMKVDxIBsVfohU48noGszboUyzlcqNj0nRFli_PjS5cdrO1Iq_kNE8lRzCZsJzImL-J5_tpFkGJLu0OCGWadb3O-cJiEeP3OLER0p5tGF-gf4Ny3cQpItWQaSO0ZXgfMNCp1KetOMStSCVR1JofiRy86ODo1g&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_february_newsletter&n=6), triggering a special election that will be held simultaneously with the May 19 primary election. We're excited to watch Ron's progress! clean_body: It's time to find Candidates | How We Win in 2026 We've been building a foundation for 4 years. Now 2026 is our time to seize the moment... and the road to change is through the PA State House. There are 203 State House seats, with a margin of only ONE seat between Republicans and Democrats! State House seats are often filled by party loyalists with no connection to their constituents. We can change that! All across the state, there are potential leaders who could run for these offices and win. The system is built to keep them out, but the Forward Party is built to let them in. Help us help them. Together, we can move Harrisburg Forward. What makes a great candidate? Connection to their community Clear communication of their ideas A collaborative, solution-oriented mindset Addressing local issues (state and community) Where can Forwardists win? Uncontested races (nearly 50% in PA) where no one is running against the incumbent Districts that aren't competitive (nearly 75% in PA) because the same party always wins Anywhere that local issues aren't being addressed by the people in charge Where to find information for your district? 1. Use the PA site to look up your house district 2. Use to find your representative and the results of past elections 3. Email mailto:Pennsylvania@Forwardparty.com to discuss running in your district (or recommend someone who can) Welcome our newest elected Forwardist! The Pennsylvania Forward Party is thrilled to announce the affiliation of the recently elected independent Mayor of Dallastown Borough, Kristine Cousler Womack. Kristine has been a friend and supporter since the beginning of our party. She attended our first Gettysburg summit in 2023 and stood with us in Harrisburg in 2024. Kristine has a long history of fighting for her community and supporting independent/3rd-party candidates. We're proud to support her Mayorship and we're looking forward to working together. Special Election Excitement Four special elections for State House races were already scheduled and we'll be reaching out to supporters in those areas to remind them to vote for these very important races . Now a fifth special election has been announced—and it's an exciting one! On January's statewide call, we heard from recently-announced Forward affiliate . He told us about his plan to run as a Forward Democrat for the PA State House in the 196th district (York County). The seat interests him because the sitting representative, Seth Grove, is not running for reelection, so this will be a great opportunity to bring something new to Harrisburg. # [Demand House Republicans Let the Clintons Testify Publicly on Epstein](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6cb01fc8-1d1b-4d16-a9bd-56f426619203/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | In a desperate attempt to draw the Epstein spotlight away from Donald Trump, Republicans suddenly demanded that Bill and Hillary Clinton testify as part of their Epstein investigation. The Clintons agreed — [**but surprised them by calling for the entire testimony to be public, so the world could see it all -- including anything said about Trump.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc5c51bd6-71da-4070-a3bd-def85741d0a8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) That's when Republicans began to furiously back away. After demanding testimony, they now appear eager to keep it behind closed doors, releasing only selective snippets while controlling the narrative and shielding Trump from scrutiny. **What are they hiding? What are they scared of? [And why is Trump suddenly saying nice things about the Clintons](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf92f0ab1-c7e3-40ef-b689-ae86c1d414c0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)?** If House Republicans are going to compel testimony, it must be public, complete, and unedited — not filtered through partisan spin.The American people deserve the full truth. [**Add your name, and tell Republicans, "If the Clintons testify, we demand you let them do it publicly, for the world to see."**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T227ae1fa-b3e3-49a8-a4d2-f1580a921c72/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:
On top of everything else Americans are dealing with right now, we’ve received confirmation that Donald Trump is coming for our elections. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jaworskifortexas.com/last-night-14192626?e=5d8d80652b)
---
| | [ ](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=a3ba81750f&e=5d8d80652b)
---
| | , On top of all the other chaos in our lives, here comes confirmation that Donald Trump is coming for our sacred American elections. Whether he claims he won in 2020 (he didn’t), cites rampant voter fraud (there isn’t), or proposes so-called “fixes” like nationwide voter ID, cancelling mail-in ballots, or even “nationalizing” elections, the point is the same. This is about power. Nationalizing elections is about as anti-American as it gets. Any patriot knows we are a Union of fifty states, with constitutionally recognized powers retained by the states and protected by the Tenth Amendment. Running elections is one of those powers. Trump knows his power is at risk. And he will do literally anything to keep his obedient MAGA Republican majority in Congress. Anything. **But isn’t it something to watch his power slipping away?** The Texas Senate District 9 special election showed us exactly what’s happening. Moderate Republicans are deeply embarrassed by Trump and are not voting for his endorsed candidates. Independent voters are swinging toward Democrats. Core Democratic voters are angry, engaged, and turning out to be heard. **The math works in our favor.** This is no time for complacency. Push the pedal to the floor. Full gas. One word: **MIDTERMS.** Republicans now hold only a one-vote advantage in the U.S. House, even after Greg Abbott deliberately delayed a special election to deny Texans their voice. That delay wasn’t accidental. It was manipulation. Just look at the pattern. Claiming victory when you lost. Screaming fire when there isn’t one. Suppressing votes instead of helping people vote. Delaying elections that could have been held earlier to silence the people. **This Republican Party is anti-vote and anti-American.** Why would anyone go that far? Because power is intoxicating. And when there are no term limits and the wrong kind of man gets hold of it, he never wants to let go. Letting go is weakness. Control is everything. They’ll tell you how patriotic they are. Such patriots. Just don’t ask questions. Just submit. Just do as you’re told. **My friends, these MAGA politics are literally killing our country.** But we don’t need weapons to fight back. We have elections. The people in the fifty states hold them. We’re going to hold them all across America. And our voices will be heard. [**Will you stand with me today and make sure your voice is heard?**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=a6524cd57f&e=5d8d80652b) Onward!

**

name: Tina Kotek
subject: Tackling homelessness in 2026
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Tina Kotek
body:
|
#
---
Peter, Just over three years ago, I declared a homelessness state of emergency.**I set ambitious state targets to prioritize reducing and preventing unsheltered homelessness in all areas of the state.** _We surpassed each benchmark set during that time,_ a testament to the change we can accomplish together when we have the resources, collaboration, and flexibility needed to get the job done. We have helped thousands of people move from the streets into shelter, from shelter into homes, and prevented thousands more from experiencing homelessness in the first place. Whenever new maps are released, misinformation follows. Partisan spin, bad-faith attacks, and deliberate confusion meant to keep voters in the dark. And that’s just the tip of the iceberg.
[**Help us fight misinformation before it has the chance to set in by rushing a donation of $3 or more right now >>>**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260206_1.p6fZ-S&amount=3&refcode=20260206-142&t=3&akid=142%2E12592%2E88dvkU)

Virginians for Fair Elections exists for this exact moment.
We are educating voters, countering false claims, and making sure Virginians understand what these maps mean and why their vote matters. We are working to ensure that voters are not misled or shut out of the process.
Across the country, MAGA Republicans are rushing to redraw maps to lock in power before voters even cast a ballot, warping representation and tilting the playing field everywhere.

This amendment makes sure that outcomes are earned, not engineered by politicians in backdoor deals. It gives voters a transparent way to review maps and have the final say, helping restore maps at a time when they’re under serious attack.
This is what we’re fighting for: educating voters, countering misinformation, and protecting fairness nationwide.
That work takes resources. It takes organizers, digital outreach, rapid response, and sustained voter education. It takes all of us stepping up, as soon as we can, to protect fairness in Virginia and help push back against national efforts to undermine representation.
[**Can we count on you to help sustain our work to pass a YES vote on fair elections by donating $3 or more today?**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260206_1.p6fZ-S&amount=3&refcode=20260206-142&t=23&akid=142%2E12592%2E88dvkU)

| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

clean_body: One day a week. A radical act of trust.| | | | | Peter, | | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud. He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus. He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness. And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible. I saw it up close -- Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything. He started observing the Sabbath. Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance. But as an act of obedience. As a way of saying, " God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped. He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield. No email. No media. No work. He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children. It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much. But over time, it changed him. And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned... This was Charlie's final message. His final act of trust. A book not about politics... but about peace. It 's called: Stop, in the Name of God. Peter, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book. It's not a culture war manifesto. It's a call to stop. To rest. To breathe. To return to God. Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away. Trust that God is in control. Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship. In Stop, in the Name of God, you'll discover: 🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout 🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again. Friend,

In less than two weeks, millions of people will gather to watch the biggest football game of the year. **Bright lights.**
**Packed hotels.** **Most people don't know this...** Wherever crowds gather, traffickers follow. Major sporting weekends bring increased travel, full hotels, busy airports, and distracted attention. **Behind the excitement ...**
**Children will go missing.** This is the perfect environment for exploitation. Law enforcement and child protection organizations know this pattern well. **Trafficking spikes around large events because vulnerability increases. **While millions are preparing for entertainment, vulnerable children are facing danger. They're not thinking about scores or highlights, but hoping to be safe - waiting for help before harm happens. This is why this moment matters. Here is a truth that should stop us cold: **9 out of 10 missing children are trafficked right here in the United States.** That's why I'm reaching out to you today. The**Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists to interrupt these moments of danger with protection, prevention, and action. We are not here for awareness alone.Awareness without action does not save a child. We are here to stop trafficking before it starts, support intervention efforts, and protect children when the risk is highest. **But this mission is not an idea. ****It is personal. **
**It is lived. **
**It is carried by those who know danger firsthand.**

My name is Theresa Flores. I'm a survivor of child trafficking. And today, I work to help protect children **before they disappear.** **I was fifteen years old. **
**An honor student. **
**A daughter. ** A girl who trusted the wrong "friend." **I was trafficked for two years.**

Most people imagine trafficking happens far away...in dark alleys...in other countries.

To "other people." **But that's not how it usually happens.** Right now, as set up for the big game is underway, **120 trained partner volunteers are already on the ground in the Bay Area**. Men and women working _this week_ --
Training hotel staff to recognize danger. Walking hotel halls, parking garages and public spaces. **Watching.**
**Reporting.**
**Protecting.** **Standing where traffickers don't expect resistance.** Children cannot choose safety on their own. They depend on adults to act when danger is highest. Freedom is not a word painted in an end zone. It's safety, dignity and the chance to grow up without fear. Your donation right now helps fund prevention programs, strengthen intervention efforts, and protect innocent lives from trafficking and abuse.It turns high-risk moments into moments of defense and hope.

clean_body: Before the big game... children will go missing While millions watch the game, traffickers target children. Here's how you can help | | | - Friend, In less than two weeks, millions of people will gather to watch the biggest football game of the year. Bright lights. Packed hotels. Most people don't know this... Wherever crowds gather, traffickers follow. Major sporting weekends bring increased travel, full hotels, busy airports, and distracted attention. Behind the excitement ... Children will go missing. This is the perfect environment for exploitation. Law enforcement and child protection organizations know this pattern well. Trafficking spikes around large events because vulnerability increases. While millions are preparing for entertainment, vulnerable children are facing danger. They're not thinking about scores or highlights, but hoping to be safe - waiting for help before harm happens. This is why this moment matters. Here is a truth that should stop us cold: 9 out of 10 missing children are trafficked right here in the United States. That's why I'm reaching out to you today. TheSound of Freedom Foundation exists to interrupt these moments of danger with protection, prevention, and action. We are not here for awareness alone.Awareness without action does not save a child. We are here to stop trafficking before it starts, support intervention efforts, and protect children when the risk is highest. But this mission is not an idea. It is personal. It is lived. It is carried by those who know danger firsthand. My name is Theresa Flores. I'm a survivor of child trafficking. And today, I work to help protect children before they disappear. I was fifteen years old. An honor student. A daughter. A girl who trusted the wrong "friend." I was trafficked for two years. Most people imagine trafficking happens far away...in dark alleys...in other countries. To "other people." But that's not how it usually happens. Right now, as set up for the big game is underway, 120 trained partner volunteers are already on the ground in the Bay Area. Men and women working this week -- Training hotel staff to recognize danger. Walking hotel halls, parking garages and public spaces. Watching. Reporting. Protecting. Standing where traffickers don't expect resistance. Children cannot choose safety on their own. They depend on adults to act when danger is highest. Freedom is not a word painted in an end zone. It's safety, dignity and the chance to grow up without fear. Your donation right now helps fund prevention programs, strengthen intervention efforts, and protect innocent lives from trafficking and abuse.It turns high-risk moments into moments of defense and hope. The game will last a few hours. Your impact lasts a lifetime. Your generosity will create awareness and help ordinary people recognize danger before another child is harmed.While millions will be watching, traffickers will be working. But so will our partners. And with your help, we can be faster and more effective in protecting children who need us most. We will place 30,000 soap packets into hotel rooms--each one printed with a missing child hotline number. That number has saved lives. Because sometimes, the only moment a child is truly alone... is in the bathroom. This is what rescue looks like before a headline or a news story. Right now, I'm asking you to do something just as important as giving. Please pray that they'll be found. Pray for the children whose names we don't know yet. Pray for the ones who are afraid to speak. Pray for courage, protection, and rescue. Jesus said, " Let the little children come to me... and do not hinder them." This is how we don't hinder them. This is how we show up. This is your moment to step onto the field for freedom. This is your chance to make the play that changes a child's future. If you feel led to take the next step, here's how your gift helps protect children during this dangerous week: $60 helps equip one trained volunteer $120 strengthens outreach and training materials $180 expands protection across multiple hotel locations $240 multiplies our presence when traffickers are most active Traffickers are already preparing. But so are we. Because of people like you. Because of prayer. God 's children are not for sale. For God's Children, Theresa Flores Freedom Fighter For the Sound of Freedom Foundation 6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074

# Heading Into 2026 Strong
---
| | Jo and Team Mendoza are heading into 2026 strong, with over **$950,000 raised in the last quarter of 2025**. Since launching her campaign in February of last year, Jo has garnered the support of **nearly 56,000 individual grassroots supporters** with an **average contribution of $27**.
The strong end to 2025 comes after Jo earned major endorsements from Arizona leaders, including **Senators Mark Kelly and Ruben Gallego** , and former **Congresswoman Gabby Giffords**.
With strong roots in the district and a strong foundation built in the off year, Jo has emerged as the clear frontrunner to take on and defeat Juan Ciscomani in November.
---

|

# Hello Sierra Vista!
---
| | In January, Jo visited Sierra Vista to join community leaders for Martin Luther King Jr. Day, where she participated in the annual MLK Day Unity March. She also had the chance to sit down with African American Leaders of the greater Huachuca area and hear about the issues that matter to them the most.

| |
# A Public Safety Roundtable in Tucson
---
| | Jo joined former **Congresswoman Gabby Giffords, Tucson Mayor Regina Romero** , and **Tucson Unified School District board member and parent Natalie Luna Rose** , for a roundtable and community conversation focused on public safety, stopping gun violence, and supporting local law enforcement.
_“Ciscomani has been absent, and we need leaders with political courage,”_**said JoAnna Mendoza**. _“The bottom line should always be that we want to create a safe community for our families. In office, I’ll work with law enforcement to get the job done on tackling crime, which we know is a real fear for families across Arizona.”_
Juan Ciscomani has broken his promise to stand with law enforcement and help keep families safe. In his first year in office, Ciscomani voted to [slash billions in funding for federal law enforcement](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=43e2884511&e=fea3203902) intended to get drugs like fentanyl off our streets, fight crime in our communities, support local police departments, and more.

# Celebrating Black History Month
---
| | Arizona’s Sixth District has a deep roots in Black military history. Fort Huachuca was home to the [Buffalo Soldiers](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=f4c1ecfcaf&e=fea3203902) \- African American regiments formed in 1866 after the Civil War, primarily serving in the U.S. Army’s 9th and 10th Cavalry and the 24th and 25th Infantry. They played a major role in the American West despite facing racism and segregation.
Their nickname is widely believed to have been given by Native American tribes, reflecting respect for their resilience and fighting spirit. This Black History Month, join us in honoring the service, sacrifice, and leadership that continues to live on in our district.

We need more volunteers to ensure we collect enough signatures to get Jo on the ballot! We’re knocking on doors and calling voters multiple times a week and would love to have YOU join us. Sign up to volunteer using the link below or email claire@joannamendoza.com to get involved.

In his first year in office, Ciscomani voted to intended to get drugs like fentanyl off our streets, fight crime in our communities, support local police departments, and more. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Celebrating Black History Month | | Arizona’s Sixth District has a deep roots in Black military history. Fort Huachuca was home to the \- African American regiments formed in 1866 after the Civil War, primarily serving in the U.S. Army’s 9th and 10th Cavalry and the 24th and 25th Infantry. They played a major role in the American West despite facing racism and segregation. Their nickname is widely believed to have been given by Native American tribes, reflecting respect for their resilience and fighting spirit. This Black History Month, join us in honoring the service, sacrifice, and leadership that continues to live on in our district. | | | Get Involved! Join us! | | A through the Arizona legislature would shift the 2026 primary date back by two weeks - which also moves our signature deadline back two weeks! We need more volunteers to ensure we collect enough signatures to get Jo on the ballot! We’re knocking on doors and calling voters multiple times a week and would love to have YOU join us. Sign up to volunteer using the link below or email claire@joannamendoza.com to get involved. If you live in Arizona’s Sixth congressional district, you can also sign Jo’s petition online to help get her on the ballot. If you’ve already signed, share the link with five friends who live in the district! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Valentines for Veterans 🩷 | | Valentine's Day is right around the corner, and we’re eager to show our love and appreciation for those who have sacrificed so much for our country - our veterans. Interested in sending your appreciation to a veteran in Southern Arizona? Mail a Valentine to us and we’ll make sure it gets to a veteran in our community that deserves a little bit of extra love this year. You can send your valentine to: Mendoza for CongressPO Box 385Marana, AZ 85653 | | | | Jo is on the Go! | | The 2026 general election is 270 days away \- and Jo is already out in the district, listening and meeting with constituents, and laying the groundwork to fight for southern Arizonans in DC. Stay tuned for when Jo will be in a community near you! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Jo in the News | | | | | Thank you! | | Jo and the rest of Team Mendoza remain grateful for your support! This campaign is about people, and we will always work to meet the needs of AZ-06. If you have any questions, do not hesitate to reach out to us. If you live in AZ-06, please take a moment to sign Jo’s nomination petition online and follow Jo on social media using the buttons below. Be sure to be on the lookout for the next time Jo will be in a community near you! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Paid for by Mendoza for Congress JoAnna Mendoza is a retired United States Marine. Use of her military rank, job titles and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the United States Marine Corps, Department of the Navy, or Department of Defense.P.O. name: Tim Walz
subject: We can’t let them win
body:
Peter,
I wanted to emphasize just how serious of a moment we are in.
Donald Trump’s federal agents are going door to door in Minnesota looking for folks based on their accent or color of their skin. Kids are afraid to go to school, small businesses are hurting, another life has been lost, and the people responsible have yet to be held accountable. Instead, Donald Trump’s DOJ is investigating me.
Why? Because my focus has always been protecting the people of Minnesota.
They’re trying to scare me and our state — but Minnesota will not be intimidated into silence and neither will I. This legal battle will be expensive, that’s why they’re doing this. They want me to back down and surrender, but I won’t.
I need your help in this fight. If you’re able, please split a donation between our Legal Defense fund and Real Texas PAC and make sure we can continue to stand up to Donald Trump and his DOJ? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp_2026_dga?refcode=partner_ms_tw_em_20260130_realtexaspac]
I'm grateful,
Tim Walz

Folks,
Last month, ICE agents abducted a Gresham family who brought their child to the hospital for emergency care.
I won’t show the faces of this family, or any of our neighbors who have been taken by our government. Instead, I’ll show you what I’m doing to bring them home.

* I am refusing to vote to fund the government unless we DEFUND and DISMANTLE ICE.
* My team and I are going to detention centers and DEMANDING to see our neighbors who are being held unlawfully and unconstitutionally.

* I introduced the CLEAR ID Act to stop ICE and other federal agents from hiding their identities while terrorizing our communities

I won’t stop fighting to make our communities safe—even from our own government. If you agree with this work, please support our campaign and help us turn the tide this November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q1?refcode=x_260206_ICErally_act]

body:
You can help us meet this moment. | | | Peter, In the face of the terror immigration enforcement is bringing to our communities, we must do what we can to curb their overreach and authority through all avenues, including in Congress. Congresswoman Delia Ramirez (IL-03) and Congresswoman Yvette Clarke (NY-09) recently introduced the **Melt ICE Act** , a bold piece of legislation that would close all private and public immigrant detention facilities, release all immigrants from detention, and end the violent for-profit electronic monitoring system. The Melt ICE Act would also redirect _billions_ of taxpayer dollars toward community-based services that support working families — instead of our tax dollars being used to fund death, destruction, and terror across the country. As families struggle to make ends meet, sometimes working two or three jobs to afford groceries and skyrocketing health care premiums, our money is being pumped into federal agencies and private detention camps that terrorize immigrants and make billionaire CEOs richer. **** [**United We Dream is mobilizing our communities to demand justice, accountability, and policies that address our needs — work that starts with the Melt ICE Act. clean_body: You can help us meet this moment. | | | Peter, In the face of the terror immigration enforcement is bringing to our communities, we must do what we can to curb their overreach and authority through all avenues, including in Congress. Congresswoman Delia Ramirez (IL-03) and Congresswoman Yvette Clarke (NY-09) recently introduced the Melt ICE Act , a bold piece of legislation that would close all private and public immigrant detention facilities, release all immigrants from detention, and end the violent for-profit electronic monitoring system. The Melt ICE Act would also redirect billions of taxpayer dollars toward community-based services that support working families — instead of our tax dollars being used to fund death, destruction, and terror across the country. As families struggle to make ends meet, sometimes working two or three jobs to afford groceries and skyrocketing health care premiums, our money is being pumped into federal agencies and private detention camps that terrorize immigrants and make billionaire CEOs richer. **** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | The respective merchants of record for transactions to United We Dream Network are ActBlue Charities Inc. subject: Take Action: Keep our power to protect our water!
body:
https://secure.ngpvan.com/kMph-P493EGqwQPd7IAMcw2?contactdata=I2n8D9zuV806xhkFvKnndqoGfkA7nXxBFvaDAjZ1SydgmXGGIMn0WOw8Ek75XVNm5E0b6QZLJUaIPYvZmVEINXWn5MD0x5NzwaK5dYrj0dKRy2nmqr+2Jk/iAom05Ehl [https://secure.ngpvan.com/kMph-P493EGqwQPd7IAMcw2?contactdata=I2n8D9zuV806xhkFvKnndqoGfkA7nXxBFvaDAjZ1SydgmXGGIMn0WOw8Ek75XVNm5E0b6QZLJUaIPYvZmVEINXWn5MD0x5NzwaK5dYrj0dKRy2nmqr+2Jk/iAom05Ehl]
Hi Peter,
Clean water is essential to all Americans, which is why there is long-standing bipartisan support for the Clean Water Act. A key part of it, Section 401, ensures that states and tribes can review federally permitted projects — like pipelines, dams, and industrial facilities — and stop or condition them if they threaten water quality. And now it’s under threat. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/kMph-P493EGqwQPd7IAMcw2]
Act now [https://secure.ngpvan.com/kMph-P493EGqwQPd7IAMcw2?contactdata=I2n8D9zuV806xhkFvKnndqoGfkA7nXxBFvaDAjZ1SydgmXGGIMn0WOw8Ek75XVNm5E0b6QZLJUaIPYvZmVEINXWn5MD0x5NzwaK5dYrj0dKRy2nmqr+2Jk/iAom05Ehl]
For nearly 50 years, Section 401 successfully protected rivers, lakes, wetlands, and drinking water. Even President Trump, during his first term, publicly stated support for protecting clean water. Yet in 2020, his administration weakened these protections, limiting states’ and tribes’ authority. In 2023, the Biden administration restored this authority, reaffirming local control to safeguard water quality.
Now, the EPA under the Trump administration is attempting to roll back Section 401 once again, making it easier for polluting industries to bypass states and tribes. This puts our water, public health, and the environment at risk.
Your voice matters. The public comment period is open through 2:00 PM PT on February 17, 2026. We need Congress and the EPA to hear loud and clear that states and tribes must retain the power to protect clean water.
Act now [https://secure.ngpvan.com/kMph-P493EGqwQPd7IAMcw2?contactdata=I2n8D9zuV806xhkFvKnndqoGfkA7nXxBFvaDAjZ1SydgmXGGIMn0WOw8Ek75XVNm5E0b6QZLJUaIPYvZmVEINXWn5MD0x5NzwaK5dYrj0dKRy2nmqr+2Jk/iAom05Ehl]
Clean water protections are not negotiable. Stand up for state and tribal authority under the Clean Water Act and help ensure that every community can access safe, clean water. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/kMph-P493EGqwQPd7IAMcw2]
Sincerely,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Britney_signature-removebg-preview.png]

clean_body: [] Hi Peter, Clean water is essential to all Americans, which is why there is long-standing bipartisan support for the Clean Water Act. A key part of it, Section 401, ensures that states and tribes can review federally permitted projects — like pipelines, dams, and industrial facilities — and stop or condition them if they threaten water quality. And now it’s under threat. [] Act now [] For nearly 50 years, Section 401 successfully protected rivers, lakes, wetlands, and drinking water. Even President Trump, during his first term, publicly stated support for protecting clean water. Yet in 2020, his administration weakened these protections, limiting states’ and tribes’ authority. In 2023, the Biden administration restored this authority, reaffirming local control to safeguard water quality. Now, the EPA under the Trump administration is attempting to roll back Section 401 once again, making it easier for polluting industries to bypass states and tribes. This puts our water, public health, and the environment at risk. Your voice matters. The public comment period is open through 2:00 PM PT on February 17, 2026. We need Congress and the EPA to hear loud and clear that states and tribes must retain the power to protect clean water. Act now [] Clean water protections are not negotiable. Stand up for state and tribal authority under the Clean Water Act and help ensure that every community can access safe, clean water. #
Friend, In November, myself and five other Members of Congress made a video quoting current law, that the military has a responsibility to refuse illegal orders. In response, President Trump tweeted more than a dozen times, calling for me to be investigated, arrested, and hanged. Since then, the FBI and former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, now U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, asked to interview me for the inquiry. I wanted to share an important update on all of this, and ask for your help. I wrote to Attorney General Pam Bondi and U.S. Attorney Pirro to inform them that I won’t be doing an interview -- and that their offices should preserve their records should I decide to sue for their infringement on my Constitutional rights. I am not going to legitimize what they’re doing. The video in question was public, and I’ve talked about it extensively in the open. Our Constitution is crystal clear about our freedom of speech – and that’s a value worth fighting for. To be honest, very smart people have told me to keep my head down and be quiet – that doing so would make this inquiry go away. But that’s exactly what Trump and Pirro want. They are employing physical and legal intimidation to get me to shut up. And, much more importantly, to deter other people from criticizing them. So I’m taking the opposite approach, and I am fighting back, because this is bigger than any one Senator or any one video. If they can do this to me, what can they do to a business leader or the head of a community foundation or a mom who goes viral on the internet for criticizing Donald Trump? And what people like Jeanine Pirro need to understand is that while the President of the United States may have immunity according to the Supreme Court, those who do his bidding do not. And if they are going to salute and do what he wants as part of this weaponization, they are going to own those consequences. We all own our choices. I own mine. And Pirro and Trump must own theirs. This is where I need your help. As I've said before, fighting back against these abuses of power requires a political strategy and a legal strategy. We're opening up an entire new front on the legal strategy -- one that goes on offense. #

Friend, it's Mark.
Most of you probably know that I am suing the Secretary of Defense. Earlier this week, I was in court to make my case against Pete Hegseth.
After 25 years in uniform and another 5 in the United States Senate, I never imagined I’d have to do something like that. Hegseth has left me no choice.
When he censured me and threatened my rank and retirement, he came after what I earned over 25 years — and chilled the free speech rights of every retired member of the military alongside me.
If Hegseth isn’t stopped, our longest-serving military veterans will have to live with the constant threat that they could be deprived of their rank and pension years — even decades — after they leave the military if they say something he doesn’t like.
I’m not going to sit by and let that happen. So, I sued Hegseth. And now, we wait and see what the court decides.
I’ve been truly humbled by the support people have sent my way over the past couple of months. It means the world to me that so many of you care about what Trump and Hegseth are trying to do.
That’s how we’ve made it this far, and it’s how we’ll get to the other side of this chapter in our nation’s history. Together.
If you’ve been waiting for the right time to make a stand and join the fight, this is it.

subject: Ilhan was assaulted during a recent town hall in Minnesota →
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20260206-1908-foote&t=1001&akid=1908%2E342411%2EGJ8KkR ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter,

Recently, during her town hall in Minneapolis, a man rushed Ilhan and
sprayed her with an unknown substance before being tackled to the ground.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260206-movement.fDSerg&refcode=em20260206-1908&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=1908%2E342411%2EGJ8KkR ]Headline: Representative Ilhan Omar Is Attacked at Town Hall in
Minneapolis.

Luckily, Ilhan is safe. But let’s be clear: this was an act of political
violence. Donald Trump and the far right have relentlessly smeared Ilhan
for years, stoking hate and encouraging threats against her and other
members of the Squad. This incident is the latest, and proof that their
attacks carry real danger, and we must take them seriously.

As long as Ilhan, Rashida, Ayanna, and Alexandria continue to speak out
bravely against the injustices being committed by this administration, we
know the threats against them will continue. We must do everything in our
power to protect them and their loved ones from every attack, physical and
otherwise, being leveled against them.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260206-movement.fDSerg&refcode=em20260206-1908&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=1908%2E342411%2EGJ8KkR ]Will you make a donation right now to help protect the Squad and make
sure they can keep fighting for us in Congress? Any amount, no matter how
large or small, makes a difference.

Campaign security is a necessary and growing expense for the Squad, and
it’s often paid for using campaign resources — resources that should be
going towards organizing, meeting with voters, and building the kind of
people-powered movement our communities deserve.

It’s beyond infuriating that, instead, campaign funds must now be used to
defend our champions against dangerous incidents like the one that
occurred during Ilhan's recent town hall.

But our champions don’t back down. It’s not who they are. In the moments
after she was assaulted, Ilhan had this to say:

“We will continue. These f*cking *ssholes are not going to get away with
this.”

She’s right,
Peter. And there has never been
a more urgent or important time to stand alongside her and the rest of our
Squad. Because this team refuses to be intimidated, and won’t let anyone
get away with putting them in harm’s way.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260206-movement.fDSerg&refcode=em20260206-1908&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=1908%2E342411%2EGJ8KkR ]A donation of any size today will make all the difference. Together, we
can make sure the Squad has enough resources to stay safe and secure and
to continue leading our progressive movement in the halls of Congress.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20260206-movement.fDSerg&refcode=em20260206-1908&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=1908%2E342411%2EGJ8KkR ]Contribute ››

In strength and solidarity,

The Squad Victory Fund

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.squadvictoryfund.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=1908%2E342411%2EGJ8KkR

Paid for by The Squad Victory Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, and Rooted in Community Leadership PAC.

In addition to what’s legally required, The Squad Victory Fund does not accept contributions from: (1) corporations, associations, or their PACs; (2) individuals registered as federal lobbyists or under FARA; (3) from the PACs, lobbyists, or SEC-named executives of fossil fuel companies; or (4) from the Fraternal Order of Police.

Contributions or gifts to The Squad Victory Fund are not tax deductible.

Contributions to The Squad Victory Fund will be allocated equally among: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib for Congress, Courage to Change, Inspiring Leadership Has a Name PAC, Power of Us PAC, and Rooted in Community Leadership PAC.

Any contributor may designate their contribution for a particular participant. The allocation formula above may change if any contributor makes a contribution that, when allocated, would exceed the amount that the contributor may lawfully give to any participant.

After contributing to The Squad Victory Fund, you will automatically be signed up to receive email updates from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress, Ilhan for Congress, The Committee to Elect Ayanna Pressley, and Rashida Tlaib for Congress. You may of course opt-out by unsubscribing at any time.

To contribute via check, please address to The Squad Victory Fund c/o MBA Consulting Group, PO Box 15845, Washington D.C., 20003

Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | A law Congress passed is starting to make its presence felt... | And that’s VERY bad news for retirees. Words matter.
They shape what we see, what we believe, and what we're willing to accept.
And right now, the left and their media allies are using them as weapons.
Want an example?
Look no further than the latest talking points:
Don Lemon is a "journalist."
The protests are "mostly peaceful."
ICE agents are "hoodlums destroying democracy."
It's easy to dismiss the headlines as just words, but they have a real effect on how Americans view reality.

From the out-of-control Trump administration allowing federal agents to terrorize our communities and alienate our allies with ridiculous trade wars to the president himself calling for Republicans to “take over” voting procedures in 15 states. Yet through all the chaos, I’m grateful to have grassroots supporters like you on my side. No matter how bad things get, you never fail to stand up, speak out, and say enough is enough. That’s why I’m asking for your help before you log off for the weekend. The truth is, there’s no Senate majority for Democrats if we lose in Virginia, so we need to prove to Trump and his Republicans that we have what it takes to protect this seat, keep Virginia blue, and finally find a better path forward for our country. = The fight continues, Mark Warner Before you go: We couldn’t be more grateful to have supporters like you stepping up during critical moments for our country. But a victory in November takes sustained engagement and support. The resources we raise now determine how many volunteers we can recruit, how many ads we can put on the airwaves, and how strong our Get Out the Vote operation is in the fall. =****** | | Friends of Mark Warner 1490-5A Quarterpath Road #213 Williamsburg, VA 23185 United States | Click here to . | Paid for by Friends of Mark Warner

subject: Too much personality? Please.
body:
This is what “too much personality” looks like. |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/124866069/599951614/-158645986?refcode=WUEFHN15_20260206_CrockettSplit_All&sourceid=1057694&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMzRkMzc1Ny04NjAzLWYxMTEtODMyZi0wMDBkM2ExZjBlNGMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ug-zk9rVxzIEhiXfFXcGZ0j0P4jfe6Ox1haidEw6FCY=) They told me I had _**too much personality**_ to play it safe.

So I became a lawyer.

I became a public defender in Texas — standing next to people who had no power, no money, and no one else fighting for them. I took on cases others wouldn’t touch. I represented Black Lives Matter activists pro bono. And I learned, early on, what it means to stand between everyday people and a system that would rather ignore them.

That’s who I was long before I ever ran for office.

But it’s also exactly why I’m running for the United States Senate now.

This campaign isn’t about climbing a ladder in Washington. It’s about bringing the same fight I learned as a public defender — the fight for fairness, dignity, and accountability — to the biggest stage there is.

**Right now, Texas has politicians who protect the powerful and leave everyone else behind. We deserve a senator who knows what it means to fight from the outside — and who isn’t afraid to take on anyone who abuses their power.**

I’ve been underestimated my whole life. I’ve never let that stop me yet. clean_body: This is what “too much personality” looks like. | = They told me I had too much personality to play it safe. So I became a lawyer. I became a public defender in Texas — standing next to people who had no power, no money, and no one else fighting for them. I took on cases others wouldn’t touch. I represented Black Lives Matter activists pro bono. And I learned, early on, what it means to stand between everyday people and a system that would rather ignore them. That’s who I was long before I ever ran for office. But it’s also exactly why I’m running for the United States Senate now. This campaign isn’t about climbing a ladder in Washington. It’s about bringing the same fight I learned as a public defender — the fight for fairness, dignity, and accountability — to the biggest stage there is. Right now, Texas has politicians who protect the powerful and leave everyone else behind. We deserve a senator who knows what it means to fight from the outside — and who isn’t afraid to take on anyone who abuses their power. I’ve been underestimated my whole life. I’ve never let that stop me yet. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Let’s show ‘em what “too much personality” looks like in the U.S. Senate. — Jasmine Crockett | = | | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Thank you for being a supporter of EMILYs List. | | **On Tuesday, I voted in support of the Fiscal Year 2026 funding package,** which provides full-year funding for jobs, education, health care, and national security priorities, along with two weeks of funding for the Department of Homeland Security (DHS). These funding bills are a rejection of the Trump administration's agenda, and supporting the package also means avoiding another harmful government shutdown. name: Mark Kelly
subject: My day in court
body:
Team, it's
Mark.

Most of you probably know that I am suing the Secretary of Defense. On
Tuesday I was in court to make my case against Pete Hegseth.

After 25 years in uniform and another 5 in the United States Senate, I
never imagined I’d have to do something like that. Hegseth has left me no
choice.

When he censured me and threatened my rank and retirement, he came after
what I earned over 25 years — and chilled the free speech rights of every
retired member of the military alongside me.

If Hegseth isn’t stopped, our longest-serving military veterans will have
to live with the constant threat that they could be deprived of their rank
and pension years — even decades — after they leave the military if they
say something he doesn’t like.

I’m not going to sit by and let that happen. So, I sued Hegseth. And now,
we wait and see what the court decides.

I’ve been truly humbled by the support people have sent my way over the

# Citigroup to match Trump Accounts
Citigroup **[will match the federal government's $1,000 seed contribution](https://substack.com/redirect/156bf5cf-de64-41db-b3ea-f44e650f289b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to "Trump Accounts" for children of its U.S. employees born between 2025 and 2028, while committing $5 million through its foundation to promote participation and support families in the tax-advantaged savings program launched under recent legislation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/156bf5cf-de64-41db-b3ea-f44e650f289b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Matching Benefit Details** : Citi's $1,000 match applies specifically to eligible U.S.-based employees' children born from January 1, 2025, to December 31, 2028, aligning with the federal seed period.
* **Foundation Commitment** : The Citi Foundation pledges $5 million to nonprofits for raising program awareness, boosting enrollment, and aiding families especially low-income ones in opening accounts.
* **Program Mechanics** : Accounts invest in U.S. stock index funds with parents able to add up to $5,000 yearly and employers up to $2,500 tax-free funds accessible at 18 for education or home down payments.
* **Corporate Trend** : Citi joins rivals like JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, and others in matching the government's contribution as part of broader employer adoption of the Trump-era initiative.

# Bitcoin bounces back dramatically, but analysts are wary
Bitcoin **[narrowly dodged a plunge below the critical $60,000 level late Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/2450eab4-839e-4ca3-b23c-60e0888b12eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** amid intense selling pressure tied to falling tech stocks and heavy liquidations, but rebounded sharply Friday morning, climbing over 7% to trade around $68,000 as of mid-morning.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2450eab4-839e-4ca3-b23c-60e0888b12eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive liquidations fuel drop** : Over $2 billion in crypto positions were liquidated Thursday, exacerbating the sell-off as forced sales hit leveraged traders.

* **Institutional exodus accelerates** : Large investors and U.S. ETFs turned net sellers in 2026 after heavy buying last year, with average ETF entry prices around $90,000 leaving many holders deeply underwater.
* **Broader crypto winter deepens** : Other major coins like Ether and XRP have fallen over 60% from peaks, with Bitcoin's correlation to volatile risk assets like tech stocks and metals amplifying the market turmoil.

**Will the Bitcoin rally last?**
Bitcoin rebounded above $69,000 on Friday after plunging as low as $61,000 overnight. Thursday's 13% drop--the steepest since the 2022 FTX collapse-- means that despite the rebound it is on track for its worst weekly performance since 2022 amid **[widespread investor fear and fatigue](https://substack.com/redirect/0a428be7-2533-484d-9f6d-f74079850d39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. It is still down more than 40% from its October all-time high above $126,000.
* **Analyst warns of deeper pain** : Markus Thielen of 10X Research predicts a possible counter-trend bounce but sees Bitcoin potentially sinking to $50,000 or lower by summer amid ongoing unwinding.
* **Analyst Sentiment Warning** : Fundstrat's Sean Farrell notes outsized fear and fatigue among crypto participants, raising his long exposure to 80% but leaving room for potential further drops into the $50,000s.
* **Massive Drawdown From Peak** : The cryptocurrency has shed more than 50% from its all-time high above $126,000 in October 2025, with a 23% year-to-date loss and fourth straight monthly decline in January.
* **Underwater ETF Holders** : Many Bitcoin ETF investors bought at averages around $90,000, creating heavy overhang and regret, making it tough to attract new Wall Street capital amid the rout.

# AI bubble fears cause Big Tech plunges
Big Tech stocks **[suffered a staggering $1 trillion wipeout](https://substack.com/redirect/09c48309-191f-4ec0-bc2f-af52556b5866?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** over the past week as fears of an AI bubble intensified, with Amazon shares plunging more than 9% on Friday after its massive $200 billion 2026 capital expenditure forecast far exceeded expectations, fueling investor concerns over unsustainable spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/09c48309-191f-4ec0-bc2f-af52556b5866?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive Capex Surge:** Amazon's projected $200 billion spending in 2026 overshot analyst estimates by over $50 billion, dwarfing peers like Alphabet's $175-185 billion range and sparking worries about over-expansion.
* **Broader Valuation Hit:** Microsoft, Nvidia, Meta, Alphabet, and Oracle joined Amazon in shedding more than $1 trillion collectively in market value during the week ending Thursday, driven by scrutiny of AI returns.
* **Mixed Wall Street Reaction:** While some firms like Meta and Alphabet saw positive responses to their forecasts earlier, Amazon and Microsoft faced sharp sell-offs, highlighting shifting sentiment from FOMO to ROI doubts.
* **Contrasting Winners:** Apple bucked the trend with a 7% gain since Monday, benefiting from strong iPhone demand and far lower AI-related capex commitments compared to its Big Tech rivals.

# Stellantis Crashes 25% on Massive 26 Billion EV Reset
Stellantis shares plunged more than 23% after the Jeep and Chrysler parent announced a staggering €22 billion **[($26 billion) charge tied to overestimating EV adoption,](https://substack.com/redirect/2648e065-42f1-418a-954f-0cec8237c137?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** forcing a major pivot away from aggressive battery-electric plans amid shifting customer demand and U.S. regulatory changes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2648e065-42f1-418a-954f-0cec8237c137?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **EV Overreach Exposed** : The bulk of the €22 billion hit stems from misjudging the speed of the energy transition, leading to canceled products and impaired EV platforms.
* **Cash and Non-Cash Split** : €6.5 billion in future cash outflows over four years for supplier compensations and reduced volumes, with €14.7 billion in non-cash impairments hitting H2 2025 results.
* **No Dividend Payout** : Company halts dividends this year and plans a €5 billion bond issuance to manage finances during the strategic reset.
* **Leadership Reset Underway** : New CEO Antonio Filosa calls it a "profound reset" to realign with buyer needs, pausing certain EV investments after prior operational missteps.

| Peter,
This week, I called into a conservative morning talk radio show where Lauren Boebert was on air bragging about her "honesty" and claiming she doesn't pretend to vote one way and do another.
So I confronted her. Live.
I pointed out that she refuses to show up in our district for a real, face-to-face town hall and that she said she "doesn't give a rip about Epstein." So I asked the simplest question of all: if she doesn't care when powerful people abuse children, what does she actually care about?
She dodged. And she exposed who she really is. Because Boebert's record doesn't match her rhetoric. Not even close:

* She claims her tele-town halls are transparent, yet her most recent Oct. 15 event was never released to the public.

* She takes credit for infrastructure projects after voting against their funding.

* She couldn't get enough support from her own R colleagues to override her favorite president's veto of the critical Arkansas Valley Conduit for clean drinking water.

* She goes on the radio claiming she supports rural hospitals--after voting to put their funding at risk.

Lauren Boebert thinks us voters are stupid. She repeatedly adds earmarks to funding bills that she herself votes against. Then she turns around and campaigns like she delivered results after she voted to kill them. Over and over again.
On air, she accused others of pretending. She's telling on herself. She is the one pretending to be good at her job. And she's hoping no one will notice.
The worst part about her response was what she failed to say. When I asked what she actually cares about, Lauren Boebert didn't even mention the hardworking people of CO-4. Not the families in Douglas. Not the farmers in Morgan or Weld Counties. Not the patients in the rural hospitals in Cheyenne Wells, Lamar, or Hugo. Maybe if she were not a carpetbagger and actually from here, she would care about our communities.
That's why I'm running--and why I need your help. Taking on a serial liar like Lauren Boebert who is backed by MAGA billionaire cash isn't easy. But I am a hometown fighter with a backbone and moments like yesterday prove that when we confront her with facts, she crumbles.

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: They are not going after criminals or the “worst of the worst”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
A new report from researchers at UC Berkeley shows that in the first nine months of the Trump administration, ICE arrests of people with zero criminal convictions increased sevenfold — making them the fastest-growing group targeted by immigration enforcement.
So let’s be clear about what’s happening: They are not going after criminals. They are not targeting the “worst of the worst.”
They are arresting people with families. Caregivers. Workers who pay taxes, keep entire industries running, and contribute to their communities every single day. Five-year-olds in little backpacks and fluffy hats.
And this isn’t just happening at the border. Deportations initiated inside the United States are up more than 4.5 times since Trump took office. ICE street arrests have surged more than elevenfold, using tactics that are increasingly aggressive, violent, and designed to instill terror in entire communities.
Once people are detained, the system is designed to keep them there. The Trump administration is illegally limiting access to bond, forcing people to choose between sitting in detention for months or giving up and self-deporting — even when they’re likely to win their cases.
At the same time, my Republican colleagues handed billions more dollars to ICE and CBP, tripling detention capacity even as border crossings declined.
And for some, there is no way out at all. This year alone, at least eight people have died in ICE custody or were killed by ICE agents or Border Patrol.
We know the names of Renee Good and Alex Pretti. Six others were lost, too: Luis Gustavo Núñez Cáceres, Geraldo Lunas Campos, Víctor Manuel Díaz, Parady La, Luis Beltrán Yáñez–Cruz, and Heber Sánchez Domínguez.
They were fathers, mothers, sons, daughters, friends, workers, neighbors.
Some of these deaths were labeled “suicides,” despite autopsies raising serious questions.
Others — like the public killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti — were dismissed by this administration by calling them “terrorists.”
These deaths are not accidents. They are the predictable result of a system built on cruelty, secrecy, and dehumanization.
As San Diegans and as a nation of immigrants, we cannot accept this. We cannot look away while people are hunted, detained, and killed under the false banner of “public safety.”
Right now, Congress is negotiating a new DHS funding bill that could potentially hand even more money to ICE and Border Patrol.
I’ll vote NO on any bill that puts Trump’s anti-immigrant agenda ahead of basic humanity — but it’s critical that the rest of your elected officials hear from you ahead of any more votes.
Call the Capitol Switchboard at (202) 224-3121 and urge your senators to block additional DHS funding.
Every person deserves dignity. Every family deserves answers. And every life lost in ICE custody or at the hands of ICE or Border Patrol agents deserves justice.
—Sara

name: Sarah McBride
subject: What Franklin Roosevelt said about dictatorships
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
As World War II raged, Franklin Roosevelt talked about how necessitous people are not free people.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=2773%2E21716%2EroBwN1)
I know that a lot of times folks see what is going on in the news — the recklessness, the violations of the rule of law, the corruption — and they go, _“how on earth can you talk about affordability? Democracy is crumbling around us, and our government and our constitution are at stake. Why are you talking about the price of groceries?”_
But one of the things I know, and I see, and I hear, is that for the vast majority of people who can't make ends meet every single day, they don't have the luxury of caring about everything else.
We owe it to them to solve their problems. One, because that is the responsibility of elected officials, and two, because if we care about the survival of our democracy, **we have to understand that economic opportunity is the foundation upon which freedom flourishes.**
When I gave my first speech on the floor of the House of Representatives, I thought long and hard about what I wanted to say. And I kept coming back to a speech that had been delivered in that same well in 1944 by Franklin Roosevelt.
As World War II raged, Franklin Roosevelt talked about how necessitous people are not free people. When you are hungry and out of a job, those are the things that dictatorships are made of.
That’s why all of us who believe in democracy in this moment, who recognize that this American experiment that started 250 years ago is at risk in this moment, need to recognize that the only way to save the American experiment is to make the American dream affordable and accessible for everyone.
**That's why I will continue to focus on it—because my constituents demand it, they need it, but also because the future of our country requires it.**
But I’m going to need your support along the way. If you’re with me in the fight to make life affordable _and_ defend our democracy, and if you’re in a position to give, please [**pitch in $5 — or whatever amount works for you — to support my campaign today.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260206-1.xVTcFL&amount=5&%3Brefcode=em20260206-2773&t=2&akid=2773%2E21716%2EroBwN1)

In solidarity,

That’s why all of us who believe in democracy in this moment, who recognize that this American experiment that started 250 years ago is at risk in this moment, need to recognize that the only way to save the American experiment is to make the American dream affordable and accessible for everyone. That's why I will continue to focus on it—because my constituents demand it, they need it, but also because the future of our country requires it. But I’m going to need your support along the way. If you’re with me in the fight to make life affordable and defend our democracy, and if you’re in a position to give, please In solidarity, Sarah McBride

body:
